blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Two Manila Water Non-East Zone operating units, Estate Water and Boracay Water, have earned international recognition from the International Water Association (IWA) after being named among the Climate Smart Utilities for 2026, highlighting their commitment to climate resilience, sustainable water management, and environmental stewardship. The recognition was conferred during the IWA World Water Congress in Glasgow, Scotland, where water utilities from around the world gathered to share strategies and best practices for addressing climate-related challenges.
